questions.question: Who is eligible for orientation?
questions.answer: Our orientation is open to students, career changers, and educational institutions. It’s designed to support anyone seeking academic or professional guidance.

questions.question: What is Diravenir?
questions.answer: Diravenir is an educational guidance platform that helps students, especially in Morocco, find study opportunities abroad. It offers personalized support in choosing programs, applying to universities, obtaining scholarships, and handling procedures such as visas and accommodation mainly in countries like China and Cyprus.

questions.question: In which countries do you assist students?
questions.answer: We assist students in exploring academic opportunities in Romania, Cyprus, and China. Whether it's for undergraduate or postgraduate studies, we provide guidance throughout the entire process from choosing the right program to securing a visa and finding accommodation.

questions.question: What scholarships are available?
questions.answer: We offer a variety of scholarship options to support students on their academic journey. You can access merit-based awards, need-based grants, and destination-specific scholarships for programs in countries like Romania, Cyprus, and China. Each opportunity includes full guidance on eligibility, application requirements, and deadlines.

questions.question: What documents are required for registration?
questions.answer: The documents required for registration typically include: a valid passport or ID, academic transcripts, proof of language proficiency, recommendation letters, and a completed application form. The entire Diravenir team will assist you in preparing and submitting all necessary paperwork.

questions.question: Do I need to speak English?
questions.answer: Speaking English is often required, depending on the program and country. However, some programs may offer support in other languages. We provide assistance in both French and English.

questions.question: Do you assist with visa and housing arrangements?
questions.answer: Yes, we assist with both visa applications and housing arrangements. Our team guides you through the entire process to ensure a smooth transition to your study destination.

questions.question: Have you worked with students before?
questions.answer: Yes, we have successfully worked with hundreds of students and continue to support many throughout their academic journeys.

questions.question: How do I start the process?
questions.answer: To start the process, you can contact us via WhatsApp or fill out our online registration form. Our team will then guide you step-by-step through the next stages.

questions.question: How do I know which study program is right for me?
questions.answer: To find the right study program for you, we offer personalized counseling based on your interests, skills, and career goals. Our experts help you explore options and choose the best fit for your future.

questions.question: What is the best time to apply?
questions.answer: It’s best to apply as soon as possible to secure your admission and scholarship. Starting early gives you the best chance to complete all requirements on time. We recommend applying between March and July for the next academic year.

about.subTitle: For The Next
about.bannerText: Transforming education for the next generation of students & learners
about.storyHeadline: Innovating new ways to guide students
about.storyParagraph1: We believe in the power of purpose-driven learning and bold imagination. We see no limits to what we can build when curiosity meets community, when dreams are backed by action.
about.storyParagraph2: We are not just educating the next generation, we are co-creating the future with them. Each scholar is a builder, a thinker, a doer. Together, we are shaping futures that matter.
about.storyParagraph3: This is more than a platform. This is a movement for those who dare to dream and work to build.
about.missionText: We aspire to empower students to succeed in life, offering not only academic orientation but also the hope and inspiration to realize their dreams abroad through international scholarships, global internships, volunteering opportunities & many more.
about.visionText: We build students' futures by providing comprehensive academic guidance, international scholarships ensuring they have the support and resources needed to succeed and realize their dreams abroad.

footer.description: DirAvenir is a web platform that supports students in their educational orientation and application procedures both in Morocco and abroad. It stands out for a personalized approach based on tests, recommendations, and follow-up before any application.
